description.value: Rusted Rake Brewing is a farm-to-tap craft brewery and gourmet eatery on a working farm in Nanoose Bay, where the barley for its beers is grown on-site alongside honey, berries, garlic, and herbs used in the kitchen. The brewery has been voted Best Brewery Food Program in BC two years running by Growler Readers' Choice Awards, and its seasonal tap list reflects whatever is growing on the farm at any given time. Set between the sea and fields of barley, the grass patio and farmhouse setting make it a standout experiential stop on Vancouver Island's craft beer trail.
